name: hero-assignment-drag
intent: Hero profile card HERO // 07 condenses into a compact dispatch proxy and travels to the DISPATCH drop zone over 740ms.

copy.liveCancelled: Assignment cancelled. HERO // 07 returned to roster.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Source becomes dashed placeholder; dispatch zone filled immediately; no proxy travel

acceptance: Assign condenses card into proxy and animates proxy from start geometry to drop zone over 740ms
Source card becomes dashed placeholder during drag; dispatch zone shows filled accent state on completion
Frozen proxy dimensions via --had-proxy-w-start/--had-proxy-w-end and board gap via --had-board-gap
Keyboard: Enter/Space on card or Assign button triggers assign; Escape cancels in-flight drag
Polite aria-live announces idle, dragging, assigned, and cancelled states
Reset button restores card, proxy, and zone; reduced motion skips proxy animation
